name: kitsu
description: Kitsu for Codex: workflow instructions for coordinating coding agents through specification, implementation, testing and review, with seven roles, shared task records and token reports. A Git check-evidence gate provides an additional safeguard. The role workflow has not been run on Codex.

interface.shortDescription: Coordinate coding agents with roles, task records and token reports
interface.longDescription: The task skill supplies coordinator and role instructions for specification, implementation, testing and review. The agent host executes the workflow; Kitsu provides shared task records, role checks and token reports. Live orchestration has not been validated on Codex. As an additional safeguard, the Git gate requires recorded passing checks before commits and pushes, and the plugin stops commands that would skip it.
defaultPrompt: Use the task skill to plan and implement a change with specialist coding agents
Show the coding-agent roles and explain the next stage of this task
